cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.13.4)

# include_directories(dfsan_rt)

include_directories(include)

option(XSAN_USE_LIVEPATCH "Use livepatch feature" ON)
set(XSAN_LIVEPATCH_GCC_LINK_SPEC_FLAG "XSAN_LIVEPATCH_GCC_LINK_SPEC")
set(XSAN_SPEC_GPP_NAME "xsan.gpp.spec" CACHE STRING
    "Filename of the g++ spec generated by XSan")
set(XSAN_SPEC_GCC_NAME "xsan.gcc.spec" CACHE STRING
    "Filename of the gcc spec generated by XSan")

# Both compiler & instrumentation depend on this lib.
# We need to add it firstly to include its utility functions.
add_subdirectory(livepatch)

add_subdirectory(runtime)
add_subdirectory(compiler)
add_subdirectory(instrumentation)

foreach(_xsan_clang_driver_target compiler xclang)
  if(TARGET ${_xsan_clang_driver_target})
    add_dependencies(${_xsan_clang_driver_target}
      ASanInstPass
      TSanInstPass
      CovSanInstPass
      MSanInstPass
      XSanInstPass)
  endif()
endforeach()
